articles.summary: Today, the governments and industry partners of Australia, Japan and the United States, together with Alcoa Corporation (NYSE: AA; ASX: AAI) (“Alcoa”), held a groundbreaking ceremony for the gallium production plant. The ceremony marked the start of construction of the new facility co-located at Alcoa’s Wagerup alumina refinery in Western Australia. Alcoa Australia President Elsabe Muller (third from right) was joined by government, industry and local stakeholders to herald the development of a new, reliable source of the critical mineral. Project partners involved in the groundbreaking event included (left to right): Executive Officer and Chief Operating Officer of the Metals, Mineral Resources and Recycling Division at Sojitz Corporation, Mr Katsunori Okada; Australian Minister for Industry and Innovation, Tim Ayres; Director General of the Minister’s Secretariat at Japan’s Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, Mr Kazumi Nishikawa; Alcoa Wagerup Alumina Refinery Operations
articles.title: Australia, Japan, the United States and Alcoa Break Ground on Gallium Project in Western Australia
